key_insight: Stateful deception aims to make attackers spend more than defenders by preserving a coherent, isolated decoy world for each recognized adversary.
engineering_relevance: Explicit state management and deterministic responses can limit LLM compute costs while supporting persistent cyber-deception environments.
method: Define a Deception Exchange Rate comparing mission-weighted adversary effort with defender resource spending.
Pair a Cowrie SSH honeypot with a local LLM constrained to render explicit state rather than store it.
Optimize deterministic handling and prompts to reduce reliance on LLM generation.
evidence_signal: Across five open-weight models, deterministic-layer and prompt optimizations reduced per-session defender cost by around 63% versus a naive all-LLM decoy.
watch_item: Per-adversary state and attacker-side effort are specified but not yet measured, so a favorable end-to-end cost exchange remains unverified.
paper_title: Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
